subject: physics

hotspots.label: Car Speed
hotspots.description: The instant speed of the car in m/s, shown live while it rolls down the track.
hotspots.positionHint: Toggling readout above the moving car.
hotspots.function: Reads the instantaneous speed while the car is moving.

hotspots.label: Motion Sensor
hotspots.description: The wall sensor that tracks distance with ultrasonic pings, feeding the graph.
hotspots.positionHint: Mount pod on the near wall with a small beam toward the track.
hotspots.function: Measures distance over time to compute the car's speed.

hotspots.label: Distance-Time Graph
hotspots.description: The live graph draws distance on the vertical axis and time on the horizontal; the slope is the speed.
hotspots.positionHint: A small screen hovering over the track showing a growing line.
hotspots.function: Displays distance over time with slope equal to speed.

hotspots.label: Distance Ticker
hotspots.description: The total meter counter used to compute average speed at the end of a run.
hotspots.positionHint: Digits plate at track edge counting accumulated meters.
hotspots.function: Totals the distance for average-speed and graph use.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC), soft vignette, no floor grid, no bulky props. A straight warm-grey track mat, small rounded car, wall-pod sensor, floating graph screen. Saturated color only on hotspot dots plus the speed readout; soft neutral studio light, no emissive, no bloom.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Track: warm paper-grey (roughness ~0.8), car body: warm amber-grey (roughness ~0.45), sensor pod warm-grey, graph screen white with dark ink graphs baked for the default gaze. Live readout numbers are an app runtime layer.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: speed as distance-over-time on a straight course, procedural graph output.

GEOMETRY: one straight track mat (length ~6 world units along +x) at y=0 with start notches. A small car (≈0.55×0.35×0.35) starting at x=-2.6. A motion-sensor pod hangs on the wall line at the -x end (xyz -1.4,0.9,0). A meter plate floats at the track edge and a graph screen (0,1.3,0.55) floats above with x=time (0-8s), y=distance (0-10m).

INTERACTION: a 3-stick Speed slider (1,2,4 m/s); Run drives the car with numerically-integrating position-advance; Stop makes distance flat; Reset re-zeros.

RUNTIME: the app drives the graph; the GLB stands static-friendly default framing.

NAMED NODES: TrackMat, Car, SensorPod, MeterPlate, GraphScreen, GroundVignette. 5-9k triangles.
